svg.title: Pancreatic islet with insulitis
svg.desc: Section through an islet of Langerhans in type 1 diabetes: lymphocytes cuff the capsule and invade a wedge of the islet, where endocrine cells are lost, among surviving and partly degranulated endocrine cells and the surrounding exocrine acini.
